summary: Iter12 — Contract Tools merger (Read/Draft/Negotiate tabs) + new flagship Pro feature Contract Negotiate + tier re-tiering (outcome/hearing/draft → pro). Backend pytest 9/9 PASS (negotiate 200 in ~85s on internal URL, analyze 200 via fixed 2-stage Gemini-extract + Claude-analyze, all 402 gates fire correctly for free users). Frontend mobile 390x844: pro user sees merged 'Contract Tools' tile, modal opens with all 3 tabs, no PRO badge on Draft/Negotiate, 2 read buttons (camera + upload) with correct accept/capture attrs, Negotiate tab fully wired (role selector, priorities textarea, analyze button appears only after file pick). Free user sees lock badges on outcome+hearing tiles, PRO badge on Draft+Negotiate tabs, tapping a locked tab opens the subscribe modal without switching tabs. No console errors. Old tile-contract_read/tile-contract_draft confirmed removed.

minor.issue: Public-URL requests >60s consistently return 502 'preview environment not responding' from the Kubernetes ingress proxy, even though backend logs show HTTP 200 OK. Backend itself works correctly (verified via http://localhost:8001 in tests). Real users on negotiate (~90s) may hit this 502 in production. Suggest either (a) reducing LLM tokens to fit in ~50s, (b) increasing ingress proxy_read_timeout, or (c) switching to a 202+polling/SSE pattern for long-running endpoints.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 3673 lines — consider splitting into routers per domain (contracts.py, hearing.py, outcome.py) before adding the next feature.

_extract_contract_text + the 2-stage Gemini→Claude pipeline is now duplicated between /contract/analyze and /contract/negotiate (and could expand further). Extract a single helper `analyze_contract_with_extraction(payload_text, sysmsg, max_tokens) -> dict` to keep them in sync.

Doc-analyze monthly quota of 10 on trial_pro is shared across analyze/negotiate/evidence. A new pro user who tests the new Negotiate feature 10 times in one month will lock themselves out of Evidence/Analyze too. Consider separate `contract_negotiate_monthly` quota or raising trial_pro doc_analyze_monthly to 30.
ContractDraftRequest accepts dict for party_a/party_b/terms — no schema validation. Consider TypedDict / nested Pydantic models so OpenAPI docs and frontend get a contract.

Lock-badge approach in the tab UI (showing 'PRO' inside the tab button) is good UX, but the visual size is small on mobile — recommend a slightly more prominent badge (gold pill) to match the dashboard tile lock style for consistency.

rca of the issue: ISSUE (external ingress 502 on long endpoints) — RCA: Kubernetes ingress (nginx) has a default proxy_read_timeout of ~60s. /api/contract/negotiate consistently takes ~80-90s and /api/contract/analyze takes ~50-75s on the trial_pro user with the test_contract.txt input due to Gemini-extract + Claude-analyze 2-stage pipeline. Backend uvicorn returns 200 OK with full body to nginx but nginx has already given up and returned 502 to the client. Repro: `time curl -sw '%{http_code}' -X POST <public>/api/contract/negotiate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <pro>' -F file=@/tmp/test_contract.txt -F priorities=... -F user_role=recipient -F language=en-GB -F country=GB` → 502 in ~60s. Workaround applied in tests: hit http://localhost:8001 directly. Long-term mitigations: (a) raise ingress proxy_read_timeout (in emergent k8s ingress config) to 180s, (b) reduce Claude max_tokens to fit under 60s, or (c) refactor to async-job + polling. Functional correctness is verified — only the proxy timeout is the bottleneck.
